longTitle.officialTitle: To extend the Public Interest Declassification Act of 2000 until 2014 and for other purposes.

main.enactingFormula: Be it enacted by the Senate and House of Representatives of the United States of America in Congress assembled,

section.heading: SHORT TITLE.
section.content: This Act may be cited as the “Public Interest Declassification Board Reauthorization Act of 2012”.

subsection.heading: Subsequent Appointment.—
subsection.content: Section 703(c)(2)(D) of the Public Interest Declassification Act of 2000 (Public Law 106-567; 50 U.S.C. 435 note) is amended by striking the period at the end and inserting “from the date of the appointment.”.

subsection.heading: Vacancy.—
subsection.content: Section 703(c)(3) of the Public Interest Declassification Act of 2000 (Public Law 106-567; 50 U.S.C. 435 note) is amended by striking “A member of the Board appointed to fill a vacancy before the expiration of a term shall serve for the remainder of the term.”.

subsection.heading: Extension of Sunset.—
subsection.content: Section 710(b) of the Public Interest Declassification Act of 2000 (Public Law 106-567; 50 U.S.C. 435 note) is amended by striking “2012.” inserting “2014.”.
